title: [Android] Balatro $9.74 (35% off) @ Google Play
body:
Deal: [Android] Balatro $9.74 (35% off) @ Google Play

[imtheonewhoknocks] According to Play Store its original price is $14.99. Save 35% at the moment until 21st Oct.
[Caped Baldy] You can click on the link in the corner and see the past posted deals…
It also says 35% off on the play store link.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/product/balatro
[ConsumerOfPumpkinPie] I've seen Balatro offers come and go, but every time I keep reading the warnings about how addicting it is…
I fear I may be too weak to resist this time…
buys
[clubhonda] It IS very addictive. But in saying that, it's not like you'll spend hours and hours in one sitting on the game. It's something you can put down whenever unlike some other games and continue when you want to, but is constantly fresh the way every hand of poker is fresh.
[tronder] it's not like you'll spend hours and hours in one sitting on the game
Speak for yourself…
[pdtmathieson] I finally cracked when I had a flight to the UK coming up. Probably spent about 16 hours of the flight on it. No regrets.
[onetwothreefour] I have earned enough through google rewards to now be able to afford this game. I am going to give it a go.
[belongsinforums] against the grain here, but found it very underwhelming
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] Get on the balatro crack pipe a bit longer and you'll get hooked.
[YoursTruly] Refusing to buy this game until it’s free.
[Jimbuscus] Doesn't work on GrapheneOS, even with containered Google Play, and as it's paid Aurora isn't viable to download it without logging in.
Only a few apps lock downloads from Google Play on uncertified AOSP which doesn't even include banking apps. To date Macca's & eBay are the only two free apps that need to be downloaded from Aurora.
Any app that's downloaded will work, as Google Play is actually installed on GrapheneOS in the container, it's just downloading that's the issue. Downloading a random APK is not ideal nowadays, but it's especially more difficult for a paid app.
So Balatro, thanks to your anti-consumer DRM, I'll never be buying this app.
